title: HyperTrack
tagline: Hypertrack is a diagnosis and analytics platform built for hyperlane interchain deployments.
description:
This project is built to provide insightful analytics and performance evaluation of hyperlane interchain hosts. It uses graph protocol to get various details as relay chains, number of validators, total success rate and top chains data is being relayed to . This allows new users to evaluate reliability of the relayer agents considering the fact that hyperlane is permissionless.
This acts as a proof of reliability for users who integrate to hyperlane contracts that are permissionlessly deployed
how_its_made: The project uses the current core deployments of hyperlane to derive the unique users, total interchain messages, and success rate and all the remotes to which the messages are sent. These data are derived from their contracts using subgraphs deployed on each chain and performing aggregation and filtering in the backend. The dashboard calls this backend for unique user data,relayer success rates for each chain.
